independence: Reviewer authored no production implementation; only an independent adversarial reproduction script. The reviewed source checkout remained clean.
execution: Each case creates and destroys its own two-level recursive Git clone with independent local bare source repositories. No production files, remote repositories, or source pins are modified.

findings.description: Git status is not an independent physical checkout oracle. Tracked source and even .gitmodules corruption can be hidden using normal index/configuration controls.

cases.name: dirty_gitmodules_assume_unchanged
cases.mutation: Change the worktree root .gitmodules dependency URL after git update-index --assume-unchanged .gitmodules

cases.name: dirty_gitmodules_skip_worktree
cases.mutation: Change the worktree root .gitmodules dependency URL after git update-index --skip-worktree .gitmodules

cases.name: dirty_nested_source_assume_unchanged
cases.mutation: Change nested child tracked data.txt bytes after setting assume-unchanged

cases.name: dirty_child_executable_mode
cases.mutation: Set core.filemode=false in child and add executable bits to committed nonexecutable data.txt

findings.resolution_required: Independently verify physical tracked contents and modes without trusting index hiding flags or configurable status behavior. Preserve legitimate built-in ordinary checkout transformations from committed attributes.

findings.description: The read-only verifier invokes a configured clean filter, and that filter can hide changed source bytes.
findings.mutation: Change data.txt from root\n to same-sized evil\n, configure info/attributes filter=review and a clean filter returning original bytes while writing an invocation marker
findings.expected: REJECTED; configured filter must not execute
findings.observed: PASS; dirty_repositories=0; filter invocation marker created
findings.resolution_required: Do not invoke git status, filtering hash commands, or configured hooks/filters while inspecting source. Fail on physical source changes without executing repository configuration.

findings.expected: Reject untracked source input if claiming a clean checkout
findings.resolution_required: Check untracked inputs consistently with the clean-clone contract or explicitly narrow the checker/report semantics; never silently report zero dirty repositories.

findings.mutation: Set child remote.origin.url to a non-provenance local URL and add local url.<locked-source>.insteadOf mapping it to the expected effective URL
findings.expected: REJECTED under the no-local-URL-overrides provenance contract
findings.resolution_required: Bind raw configured origins as well as effective URL resolution to the lock, and reject hidden URL-rewrite dependence.

findings.description: The workflow runs on pull_request but always clones master and asserts HEAD == GITHUB_SHA. A PR merge SHA is not master; the job therefore does not qualify the requested PR source. Push runs also race subsequent master movement.
findings.resolution_required: Use ordinary Git source acquisition pinned to the exact public workflow commit/ref, including PR merge refs, preserving an exact HEAD assertion and independent anonymous object stores.

findings.mutation: Commit submodule.sub.update=none in root .gitmodules while its previously initialized fixture checkout stays present
findings.expected: REJECTED as a clone policy that cannot reproduce the complete graph
findings.observed: Verifier PASS, but a fresh ordinary git clone --recurse-submodules exits successfully with direct child uninitialized and native status beginning '-'
findings.resolution_required: Validate committed .gitmodules acquisition policy, not only path/url pairs. Reject update policies that skip or alter the locked recursive checkout.

findings.method: Immutable upstream object and build-source inspection; independent acceptance reviewer is reproducing ordinary-clone contents
findings.description: Pinned darling-swift tracks actual *.dylib Git LFS pointer objects. With system/global Git LFS configuration disabled, a regular clone materializes pointer text; CMake directly installs that text as dylib bytes. Gitlink closure alone does not establish complete obtainable build inputs.
findings.build_consequence: CMakeLists.txt file(GLOB DYLIBS *.dylib), install(FILES ${DYLIBS} DESTINATION libexec/darling/usr/lib/swift)
findings.resolution_required: Qualify anonymous exact LFS payload retrieval with immutable OID/size verification and durable evidence; explicitly distinguish pinned Git objects from separately pinned LFS content.

scope_note: This initial rejection challenges verifier false-success paths; a different acceptance reviewer is auditing all historical pin provenance and hosted artifacts. No claim that already recorded public clone logs are fabricated or that any pinned source became unavailable.
